title: Trace anomaly, effective approach, and gravitational potential
summary: We explore and discuss corrections to the Newton potential from the quantum effects of conformal matter fields. In this special case, one can compare different approaches, including that of effective quantum gravity and another, based on the conformal (trace) anomaly. The comparison of these two methods is the main focus in the present work. Using the anomaly-induced effective action of gravity requires fixing the quantum vacuum state, similar to what is done in the description of black hole evaporation.
